question: Should `policy watch --interval-ms` continue accepting equivalent plus-prefixed and zero-padded decimal spellings, or intentionally require only canonical unpadded numerals?
rationale: Current behavior explicitly accepts these spellings, documentation does not forbid them, and they produce the same numeric interval, so narrowing the public CLI contract requires Policy-owner intent rather than a correctness inference.

options.title: Preserve accepted spellings
options.body: Remove the canonical-string equality restriction and retain the existing safe-integer and minimum validation because no incorrect cadence is demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt canonical-only syntax
options.body: Approve the compatibility break, document the exact numeral grammar, and require supported-Node before/after/control CLI proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve accepted spellings
recommendation.body: Remove the canonical-string equality restriction and retain the existing safe-integer and minimum validation because no incorrect cadence is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Policy plugin and the watch command containing this parser.
